text:
Market today: The mood is sour for big tech. Earnings from Apple and Palantir, despite some positives, led to slides, driving the real market sentiment. This directly impacts your heavily concentrated tech/chip book.

Your holdings: SOXL (-69.67%), MUU (-42.78%), and SMCI (-30.63%) are your deepest losses, all in chips or tech. PLTU (-13.61%) is directly hit by Palantir news. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on your leveraged ETFs like PLTU and METU, and the broader QQQ, for continued weakness. Monitor your stops diligently.

Bottom line: Today is about aggressive risk management, especially for your leveraged and deeply underwater positions.
plays: PLTU: Palantir news is negative. Consider trimming this leveraged position or tightening your stop at 49 to manage risk.
SOXL: Your 3X leveraged SOXL is down almost 70%. Its stop at 200 is ineffective; re-evaluate this position and set a realistic stop immediately.
QQQ: Watch your QQQ position closely as it approaches its stop at 670, given the broader tech weakness.
